entities.summary: Sigitas Parulskis (b. 1965-02-10, Obeliai) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Obeliai and Lithuania. Known in the fields of lithuania, poets & playwrights, europe.
